create_sequence_parallel_leading_matmul: create a sequence parallel leading matmul operation that gathers scattered input across ranks and performs linear transformation
run_sequence_parallel_leading_matmul_fwd: run the forward pass of sequence parallel leading matmul with fused allgather and linear or separate gather then matmul
run_sequence_parallel_trailing_matmul: run the forward pass of sequence parallel trailing matmul that performs linear transformation and reducescatter output across ranks
test_sequence_parallel_leading_matmul_bw: test the backward pass of sequence parallel leading matmul computing gradients for scattered input and weight shards
review_sequence_parallel_trailing_matmul: review the backward pass of sequence parallel trailing matmul computing gradients for gathered input and weight
